overview:
**High fire danger today, driven by very low humidity (18%, exceeding the local watchout threshold) and warm, dry NE breezes.**
- Danger climbs to Very High by Thursday-Friday as ERC rises toward the 90th percentile.
- Watchout status: 1 of 7 local thresholds met (minimum relative humidity).
- No rain expected through midweek; light showers possible Aug 21-22.
- Fire restrictions remain active: Gunnison County is in Stage 2 Fire Restrictions, with no open burning or campfires allowed; BLM Uncompahgre Field Office restrictions cover Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, and Delta counties.
- Nearby: the Gold Mountain Fire is burning in southwest Colorado, originating two miles north of Ouray, now 39,674 acres and 87% contained with structure protection ongoing; the Elk Fire on the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF is 7,374 acres and 35% contained.
